skills.detail:
Reduces damage received from enemies while the skill button is held down.
Deals a long-range area attack after a certain period of time or when the skill button is released.
Adds the amount of reduced damage received from enemies while the skill is active to the damage dealt to enemies.
However, any damage reduced by Trait effects will not be added.
Attack ignores obstacles.
Reduces chance of getting pushed away when attacked by enemy while the skill is active.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: Ursa Shock

skills.detail:
When You or the Enemy Has a Treasure Area with an Enemy Present:
Moves you to the nearest Treasure Area belonging to your team or the enemy's with an enemy present.
Plus, a long-range area attack.

When You and the Enemy Have No Treasure Areas with an Enemy Present:
A long-range area attack.

Damage dealt will disregard damage reduction.
Deals increased damage to Runners.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
There is a cooldown in effect for a set period of time at the start of battle.
